selector.rationale: Progressive deterioration of vision and proptosis with a heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof and an expansive lytic bony lesion involving the orbit, which is more consistent with fibrous dysplasia

rejected.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
rejected.why: No mention of cafe-au-lait spots, neurofibromas, or other characteristic features

rejected.label: Orbital osteoma
rejected.why: The presence of a heterogeneous enhancing mass and an expansive lytic bony lesion is not typical of osteoma
